title: The Teacher Who Needed Children and the Rebbe’s Promise
blurb: When a non-Lubavitch teacher from Yerushalayim came to the Rebbe seeking a bracha for children, she never imagined that a teaching job at Beis Rivkah in New York would become the answer to her tefillos. "When you care for the Rebbe's children, the Rebbe will care for yours," the Rebbe told her.

title: He Wanted a Better Way to Learn the Rebbe’s Maamarim, So He Built One
blurb: A personal effort to track his progress in learning the Rebbe’s 210 mugah maamarim by R' Kasriel Warlow-Shill, has grown into an ambitious online project offering a structured learning program, community support, and bonuses to encourage consistent learning and completion.

title: Sydney Educator Turns Daily Tanya Sketches Into New Book
blurb: What began as a simple classroom teaching tool has grown into a daily resource shared with hundreds of people — and now, a published book.

title: Vayetzei: We Need Only to Open the Eyes
